info.name: Account Account API SEO Research API API

params.name: query
params.description: Domain, URL, subdomain, or path to analyze. Accepts full domains (example.com), complete URLs (https://example.com/blog), subdomains (blog.example.com), specific paths (example.com/products/), or individual pages.

params.name: compareDomain
params.description: Domain to compare against when evaluating where it outranks you and where you outrank it.

params.name: includeTerms
params.description: Comma-separated list of terms that must be present in the keyword.

params.name: includeAnyTerm
params.description: Used with includeTerms. If true: match any term (OR). If false: require all terms (AND).

params.name: excludeTerms
params.description: Comma-separated list of terms to exclude from results (e.g., branded or irrelevant terms).

params.name: excludeHomepageKeywords
params.description: If true, exclude keywords where the domain/URL's homepage (root domain, e.g., example.com) ranks; if false, include all.

params.name: searchVolume.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where monthly search volume (Google) is ≥ this value.

params.name: searchVolume.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where monthly search volume (Google) is ≤ this value.

params.name: keywordDifficulty.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the keyword difficulty score is ≥ this value (0-100; higher = harder to rank).

params.name: keywordDifficulty.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the keyword difficulty score is ≤ this value (0-100; higher = harder to rank).

params.name: rank.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the domain/URL rank position is ≥ this value (1 = best/top organic result).

params.name: rank.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the domain/URL rank position is ≤ this value (1 = best/top organic result).

params.name: rankChange.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the domain/URL improved by at least this many positions vs. the previous month (rank_change ≥ value). Positive values mean moved up; negative values mean moved down.

params.name: rankChange.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the month-over-month rank change is at most this many positions (rank_change ≤ value). Positive values mean moved up; negative values mean moved down.

params.name: costPerClick.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the average cost per click (CPC) is ≥ this value.

params.name: costPerClick.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the average cost per click (CPC) is ≤ this value.

params.name: costPerClickOption
params.description: Match type for CPC filtering. Broad = includes variations/related terms; Exact = exact keyword only; Phrase = contains the keyword phrase in order (with additional words allowed).

params.name: seoClicks.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where estimated monthly organic clicks (SEO clicks) to the domain/url are ≥ this value.

params.name: seoClicks.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where estimated monthly organic clicks (SEO clicks) to the domain/url are ≤ this value.

params.name: seoClicksChange.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the month-over-month change in estimated organic clicks is ≥ this value. Positive values indicate click gains; negative values indicate click losses.

params.name: seoClicksChange.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the month-over-month change in estimated organic clicks is ≤ this value. Positive values indicate click gains; negative values indicate click losses.

params.name: percentMobileSearches.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the mobile search share (%) is ≥ this value (range 0-100).

params.name: percentMobileSearches.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the mobile search share (%) is ≤ this value (range 0-100).

params.name: percentDesktopSearches.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the desktop search share (%) is ≥ this value (range 0-100).

params.name: percentDesktopSearches.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the desktop search share (%) is ≤ this value (range 0-100).

params.name: percentNotClicked.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the percentage of searches with no click is ≥ this value (range 0-100).

params.name: percentNotClicked.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the percentage of searches with no click is ≤ this value (range 0-100).

params.name: percentPaidClicks.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the share of SERP clicks going to paid ads (%) is ≥ this value (range 0-100).

params.name: percentPaidClicks.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the share of SERP clicks going to paid ads (%) is ≤ this value (range 0-100).

params.name: percentOrganicClicks.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the share of SERP clicks going to organic results (%) is ≥ this value (range 0-100).

params.name: percentOrganicClicks.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the share of SERP clicks going to organic results (%) is ≤ this value (range 0-100).

params.name: monthlyCost.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the estimated monthly advertising cost is ≥ this value.

params.name: monthlyCost.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the estimated monthly advertising cost is ≤ this value.

params.name: monthlyCostOption
params.description: Match type for monthly cost filtering. Broad = includes variations/related terms; Exact = exact keyword only; Phrase = contains the keyword phrase in order (with additional words allowed).

params.name: paidCompetitors.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the number of distinct advertisers observed over the last 14 months is ≥ this value.

params.name: paidCompetitors.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the number of distinct advertisers observed over the last 14 months is ≤ this value.

params.name: rankingHomepages.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the number of homepage/root-domain URLs in the top 100 results is ≥ this value.

params.name: rankingHomepages.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the number of homepage/root-domain URLs in the top 100 results is ≤ this value.

params.name: totalMonthlyClicks.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where total monthly SERP clicks (all domains) are ≥ this value. Independent of rank; includes both organic and paid clicks.

params.name: totalMonthlyClicks.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where total monthly SERP clicks (all domains) are ≤ this value. Includes both organic and paid clicks.

params.name: adCount.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the number of distinct advertisers observed over the last 14 months is ≥ this value.

params.name: adCount.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the number of distinct advertisers observed over the last 14 months is ≤ this value.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of rows returned.

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Country market to search. Specifically, this maps to the Google domain version to query against (e.g., google.com for US, google.de for Germany, etc.). All Countries

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Column to sort results by.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Order to sort the results.

params.name: startingRow
params.description: Row number to start the results with.

params.name: adultFilter
params.description: Exclude adult keywords considered unsafe for work.

params.name: onlyAdultKeywords
params.description: Only include adult keywords considered unsafe for work.

params.name: exactMatch
params.description:
Indicates whether to apply exact match filtering for the query.
This parameter will result in **only** exact matches,
meaning protocols (http/https) and trailing slashes **must** be included.
For example, a query of "https://example.com/blog" will not match
- "example.com/blog"
- "https://example.com/blog/"

Returns keywords where the query domain recently surpassed the comparison domain in organic search rankings. This endpoint identifies competitive shifts where one domain has overtaken another, either through ranking improvements, competitor declines, or both.
